generation_state_shape.name: generation_state_shape
generation_state_shape.value:
("generation"."state" = 'pending' AND "generation"."attempt_id" IS NULL AND "generation"."output" IS NULL AND "generation"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR
    ("generation"."state" IN ('running', 'uncertain') AND "generation"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "generation"."output" IS NULL AND "generation"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR
    ("generation"."state" = 'succeeded' AND "generation"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "generation"."output" IS NOT NULL AND "generation"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR
    ("generation"."state" = 'failed' AND "generation"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "generation"."output" IS NULL AND "generation"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)

qa_run_state_shape.name: qa_run_state_shape
qa_run_state_shape.value: ("qa_run"."state" = 'open' AND "qa_run"."disposition" IS NULL AND "qa_run"."operator_notes" IS NULL AND "qa_run"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("qa_run"."state" = 'finalized' AND "qa_run"."disposition" IS NOT NULL AND "qa_run"."operator_notes" IS NOT NULL AND "qa_run"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

story_passage_decision_valid.name: story_passage_decision_valid
story_passage_decision_valid.value: ("story_passage"."decision_plan" IS NULL) = ("story_passage"."response_due_at" IS NULL) AND ("story_passage"."decision_plan" IS NULL OR ("story_passage"."interaction" IS NOT NULL AND "story_passage"."wait_plan" IS NULL))

story_passage_response_source_valid.name: story_passage_response_source_valid
story_passage_response_source_valid.value: "story_passage"."response_source" IS NULL OR ("story_passage"."response" IS NOT NULL AND "story_passage"."response_source" IN ('player', 'default'))

story_passage_control_valid.name: story_passage_control_valid
story_passage_control_valid.value: "story_passage"."control_revision" >= 0 AND ("story_passage"."remaining_ms" IS NULL OR ("story_passage"."remaining_ms" >= 0 AND "story_passage"."wait_plan" IS NOT NULL))

story_passage_generation_part.name: story_passage_generation_part
story_passage_generation_part.value: ("story_passage"."source_generation_id" IS NULL AND "story_passage"."source_generation_part" IS NULL) OR ("story_passage"."source_generation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "story_passage"."source_generation_part" IN ('current', 'arrival'))

storyteller_run_bounds.name: storyteller_run_bounds
storyteller_run_bounds.value: "storyteller_run"."limit_microusd" >= 0 AND "storyteller_run"."settled_microusd" >= 0 AND "storyteller_run"."reserved_microusd" >= 0 AND "storyteller_run"."max_attempts" > 0 AND "storyteller_run"."admitted_attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND "storyteller_run"."max_attempts"
